_comment: Retired challenge slugs/ids. Reusing one would let a former challenge's locally-stored student progress (keyed by slug) inherit onto a new, unrelated challenge, or revive a retired /challenge/<id> alias. Add an entry when you delete or rename a challenge whose slug/id you do not want reused. FORMAT: "slugs" holds file basenames (e.g. "caesar-01"); "ids" holds challenge id STRINGS (e.g. "py059", "apcs003") — never the bare number 59 or the string "59". scripts/new-challenge.ts refuses to scaffold if any entry is malformed.
